name: 墓场巨型无畏机甲
description: 三十英尺高的巨型战斗自动机甲，以腿部与背部火箭推进器悬停和飞行；光学传感器自主扫描并锁定物体，一只集成式巨臂可转换为大型能量炮，运行时发出古老齿轮研磨声、火箭轰鸣与重复机械语音。

variants.appearance: 三十英尺高的庞大黄铜装甲机甲，表面呈长期暴露后的陈旧质感，装有红色光学传感器、腿部与背部火箭推进器，其中一只巨臂集成大型炮管。
variants.stage1_prompt: Thirty-foot Victorian steam siege automaton, overwhelming octopus silhouette: riveted pressure-vessel body hangs low beneath an armored dome, sensor block buried behind a shuttered optic. Eight articulated limbs span a footprint, built from cast-iron drum joints, bevel gears, chain drives, pistons, hoses, locking collars, and clamp feet. Four act as bridge supports, two seize hulls, rear pair mount bell-mouthed rocket thrusters fed by a boiler manifold. One forward limb terminates in an energy cannon with rotating induction rings, recoil rails, and flywheel generator. Machinery crowds every joint; curved armor protects only the boiler. Low body, towering limb arches, and reach create crushing scale.
